coordinates.note: Nominatim (OpenStreetMap geocoder) point for the institute, 19B Yuquan Road, Shijingshan District, Beijing. A geocoder gives a campus-grade location only: read it as the campus marker, not the position of the BEPCII ring or the BESIII hall, which no source consulted locates.

name: IHEP Beijing campus (Yuquan Road)
notes: Campus point only. No fetched source gives coordinates for the BEPCII ring or the BESIII hall; the detector placements for BES, BES-II and BESIII therefore use this campus point and are shown as approximate.

summary.plain: The main campus of the Institute of High Energy Physics in western Beijing, where the Beijing Electron-Positron Collider and the BESIII experiment are located.
summary.technical: IHEP Beijing campus, 19B Yuquan Road, Shijingshan District, Beijing; hosts BEPC/BEPCII, the BES detectors and the Beijing Synchrotron Radiation Facility. The point is a geocoder (OpenStreetMap/Nominatim) campus marker, about 500 m precision.
